mapper.select: SELECT a.*, b.id,b.roleName,b.roleCode, b.des FROM 系统_用户角色表 a left join 系统_角色表 b on a.roleId=b.id where a.userId=#{userId}
select * from 系统_菜单权限表 where id in ( select distinct menuId from 系统_角色菜单表 where roleId in( select roleId from 系统_用户角色表 where userId=#{userId}))
select * from 系统_菜单权限表 where parentId=#{parentId}
select menuId from 系统_角色菜单表 where roleId=#{roleId} order by id
mapper.delete: delete from 系统_角色菜单表 where roleId=#{roleId}
mapper.insert: insert into 系统_角色菜单表(roleId,menuId) values (#{roleId},#{menuId})
